## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Dhammadevaputtacariya* (Cp 18, also titled *Dhammādhamma-Devaputta-Cariya*) is a short poetic narrative in the *Cariyāpiṭaka* of the Khuddaka Nikāya [Bareau]. The text recounts a past life in which the Bodhisatta was reborn as a deity of great psychic power and authority named Dhamma, who was moved by deep compassion for the beings of all worlds [Bareau].

 Internal text reuse is identified by DharmaNexus exclusively with the text's traditional Pali commentary, the *Cariyāpiṭaka-aṭṭhakathā*, which shares seven matching segments (532 characters in total), the longest alignment running between segments 4.2–5.4 of the base text and paragraphs 1144–1147 of the commentary [DharmaNexus].
